answer: Random peer audit guards the harbor. Each epoch a beacon draws five random auditors per identity, like boats checked at a narrow inlet. Each auditor replays the signed work proof; a forged proof fails and its 60-coin deposit is slashed. A forger running 1,000 fake identities pays 60,000 coins against a 30,000-coin monthly pool, so the attack loses twice over. An honest agent pays once, passes each audit and keeps full earnings, firm as a cedar.
